calculation_handling.description: An ancillary outdoor area for parking or storing more than 3 vehicles must be at least 6.0 metres from a residential building on the same lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the location of the outdoor parking area; applies only to lots with a residential building other than a detached house, semi-detached house or duplex.

evidence.parking_space: parking or storing of more than 3 vehicles

calculation_handling.description: The ancillary outdoor area for parking more than 3 vehicles must be fenced, except the portions used for vehicle or pedestrian access.

units.disclosure: An outdoor parking area for more than 3 vehicles must be fenced except for access portions. The tool does not evaluate this.

calculation_handling.description: The surface used for parking or storing vehicles must be no closer to a fence than 1.5 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: No modelled target for the distance to a fence.

units.disclosure: The parking surface must be at least 1.5 metres from a fence. The tool does not evaluate this distance.

calculation_handling.description: The ancillary outdoor area must be no closer to a lot line that abuts a street than the greater of 6.0 metres and the setback of a residential building on the adjoining lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The adjoining lot's setback is not licensed as a model input for this clause.

units.disclosure: The outdoor parking area must be set back from a street lot line by the greater of 6.0 metres and the setback of the adjoining residential building. The tool does not compute this.

evidence.parking_space: parking or storing of more than 3 vehicles

calculation_handling.description: At most one ancillary building for parking attendants, with a maximum height of 3.0 metres, a maximum floor area of 5.0 square metres, and no closer than 6.0 metres to any lot line abutting a street.
calculation_handling.gaps: Several limits in one clause with one count; no single modelled target.

units.disclosure: An outdoor parking area for more than 3 vehicles may have one attendants' building, at most 3.0 metres high and 5.0 square metres in floor area, at least 6.0 metres from any street lot line. The tool does not compute this.

10.5.80.1(1).explanation: A parking space that the by-law requires must stay available for the use it serves.

10.5.80.1(2).explanation: A lot with a residential building other than a detached house, semi-detached house or duplex may have an outdoor parking or storage area for more than 3 vehicles if it is 6.0 m from residential buildings, fenced, 1.5 m inside the fence, set back from the street by at least 6.0 m or the neighbour's setback, and has at most one small attendants' building.
